{"prose_translation": "And his mother kept all these sayings in her heart."}
{"prose_translation": "And it happened that, while they were there, the days for her to give birth were fulfilled,"}
{"prose_translation": "And there were shepherds in that same region, living in the fields and keeping watch over their flock by night."}
{"prose_translation":"And the angel said to them, \"Do not be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy, which will be for all the people,"}
{"prose_translation": "that today a Savior was born for you, who is Christ the Lord, in the city of David;"}

{"prose_translation": "And it happened, when the angels went away from them into heaven, that the shepherds said to one another, \"Let us go now as far as Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.\""}
{"prose_translation": "And when they had seen it, they made known concerning the saying that had been spoken to them about this child."}
{"prose_translation": "And all who heard it were amazed at the things spoken to them by the shepherds,"}
{"prose_translation": "but Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart"}
{"prose_translation": "And his father and mother were marveling at the things being spoken about him."}
{"prose_translation": "And coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to God and spoke about him to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem."}
{"prose_translation": "And when they had finished everything according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city Nazareth."}
{"prose_translation": "And the child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him."}
{"prose_translation": "And his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the Passover."}

{"prose_translation": "as they were going up according to the custom of the feast and had completed the days, while they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, and his parents did not know it"}
{"prose_translation": "and when they did not find him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking him."}
{"prose_translation": "and it happened that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers and listening to them and asking them questions;"}
{"prose_translation": "And all who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers."}
{"prose_translation": "And he said to them, \"Why is it that you were looking for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's [house]?\""}
{"prose_translation": "And they did not understand the saying that he spoke to them."}
